questions.question: What is the first step when you notice a tripping hazard in a work area?
options: Report it only if someone falls
Control or remove the hazard and report it
questions.explanation: Hazards should be controlled immediately if safe to do so, then reported according to site procedure.

questions.category: A2 — Interpret OHS regulations and WorkSafeBC standards
questions.question: Why must workers follow occupational health and safety regulations?
options: They help protect workers from injury and illness
questions.explanation: Safety regulations set minimum requirements to protect workers and the public.

questions.question: Which space could be considered a confined space?
options: Small room with normal doors and windows
Tank, crawlspace, or enclosed vessel with limited entry
questions.explanation: Confined spaces often have limited access and may contain hazardous atmospheres.

questions.category: A4 — Use fall protection systems and equipment
questions.question: When is fall protection commonly required?
options: When there is a risk of falling from height according to regulations
questions.explanation: Fall protection is required when workers are exposed to fall hazards.

questions.question: Which PPE protects the eyes from paint splashes and flying particles?
questions.explanation: Eye protection is required when there is risk of splash, dust, or flying material.
